chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: حَمْدَوَيْهُ بْنُ نَصِيرٍ، عَن يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَن الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينَ - وَكَانَ سَيِّئَ الرَّأْيِ فِي يُونُسَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ - قَالَ: قِيلَ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَ أَنَا أَسْمَعُ:

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh ibn Nusayr, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin – and he had a negative opinion of Yunus, may Allah have mercy on him – said: it was said to Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) while I was listening:

chunks.arabic_text: أَنَّ يُونُسَ مَوْلَى آلِ يَقْطِينَ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَالْمُتَمَسِّكَ بِطَاعَتِكُمْ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ عَلَى سَبْعِينَ حَرْفًا، وَيَقُولُ إِنَّهُ شَاكٌ، قَالَ: فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: هُوَ وَ اللَّهِ أَوْلَى بِأَنْ يَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ عَلَى حَرْفٍ، مَا لَهُ وَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ لَمِنَ الْمُخْبِتِينَ.

translations.en: Yunus the client of the family of Yaqtin claims that your follower and the one who holds on to your obedience – Abdallah ibn Jundab – worships Allah on seventy edges [allusion to Q. 22:11] and also says that he is a doubter, so I heard him saying: he is by Allah more likely to worship Allah on the edge, what does he have to do with Abdallah ibn Jundab! verily Abdallah ibn Jundab is one of the humble ones [allusion to Q 22:34].

en.summary: This hadith from Al-Kashi’s Rijal highlights the scholarly debate regarding Yunus ibn Abi al-Yaqdhan’s critical stance toward Abdallah ibn Jundab, who was accused of 'shak' (doubt) and holding a superficial understanding of worship ('seventy edges'). The Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) refutes this by affirming Ibn Jundab’s true piety and humility ('al-mukhbitin'), demonstrating that outward criticism by scholars does not necessarily reflect the inner spiritual reality of the individual.
en.seo_question: Why did the Imam defend Abdallah ibn Jundab against Yunus's criticism?

key_terms.يونس: Yunus, a companion known for his critical view of others
key_terms.عبد الله بن جندب: Abdallah ibn Jundab, a companion praised by the Imam
key_terms.سبعين حرفا: Seventy edges, a Quranic allusion to those who call to evil and then take it as a way out, implying superficial faith
key_terms.المخبتين: The humble/devout, referring to those who are humble in prayer and faith
